title: 278. Gray Code

examples.explanation: Binary forms 00, 01, 11, 10 change one bit at each step.
With one bit, 0 then 1 differ in the only position.
Zero bits still produce the single value 0.

hints: Entry i of the binary-reflected code is i ^ (i >> 1).
Alternatively mirror the (n-1)-bit sequence and set the top bit on the reversed copy.
Any ordering is accepted as long as it starts at 0, covers all values, and flips one bit per step.
